name: GammaRips
description: The options-flow data layer for AI agents. 9 MCP tools over the GammaRips engine: the curated overnight unusual-options-activity pool (with a free preview), point-in-time feature vectors, opportunity surfaces (realized excursion distributions), a queryable outcome database, exit-rule scoring, the raw option price tape, regime context, and methodology playbooks. No pick endpoint, deliberately; your agent reasons to its own conclusion. Data on a paper-trading basis, educational only. Not investment advice.

auth.instructions: Subscribe at https://gammarips.com/pricing ($39/mo, 7-day free trial); after checkout, generate your API key at https://gammarips.com/account (it is shown once, at creation). Send it as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. Without a key, an anonymous funnel tier is available: pool preview, daily reports, methodology playbooks, and reference tools.
